recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-26636 unless OO chooses a new policy change about where device category definitions should live; device-list and UDI guidance from FHIR-26378 should remain separate.
issue_request: FHIR-26636 was a Published OO change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking FHIR core to clarify the meaning and scope of implantable, patient-use, and related device categories. The final resolution was to add the general device-type scope clarifications to Device and DeviceDefinition.
initial_application: Jira says the work was added to the build via PR 1440 and commit b1e2ad6, although that linked merge commit does not itself touch the current Device introduction files in this checkout. Git pickaxe history shows fb49621b478c7042ca441689c61e1cf7f8b4b5c2 added implantable and patient-use breakdown text to both source/device/device-introduction.xml and source/devicedefinition/devicedefinition-introduction.xml on 2021-09-29; 3c23148747a7d0fead21ff9afaab2fc3bb65eae9 later expanded the Device scope and boundaries text.
additional_context: Device and DeviceDefinition are active current-build resources in source/fhir.ini. Later R6 device text work, especially 3cf635fa2b606d038462a683a53338e39b3f30e3, moved most detailed category descriptions from Device to DeviceDefinition while leaving Device with category examples and a link to DeviceDefinition for detailed category descriptions. OO Confluence minutes mention FHIR-26378/FHIR-26636 in the DeviceUsage/DeviceRequest backlog, but those references do not conflict with the current category-definition placement.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/device/device-introduction.xml states the Device scope, names implantable and home/patient-use-related categories, and links to DeviceDefinition for detailed descriptions. Current source/devicedefinition/devicedefinition-introduction.xml contains detailed implantable, home-use, patient-use, and personal-health category descriptions.

related_jiras.note: OO minutes mention FHIR-26378 alongside FHIR-26636 in the DeviceUsage/DeviceRequest backlog, but it concerns device-use/request modeling and UDI IG follow-up rather than the category-definition clarification decided here.
Later Device scope and boundaries work expanded the Device narrative while preserving the category clarification.
R6 Device text cleanup moved detailed category descriptions to DeviceDefinition and left Device pointing there, affecting placement but not the substance of FHIR-26636.
